note: DubBot Toolbar is a trivial glue submodule of DubBot. It has no config, no permissions, no schema of its own; it implements one hook_toolbar() (via Drupal\dubbot_toolbar\ToolbarHandler) that renders a toolbar_item built from the parent's dubbot.link_generator, reusing dubbot's permissions. It depends on core toolbar and dubbot. Its only observable state is whether it is enabled. Medium/hard cases are therefore grounded in the module's enabled state (drush pm:list / moduleHandler). Baseline: the submodule is OFF by default; cleanup/reset uninstall it.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal dubbot_toolbar submodule add, and which core hook does it implement to do it?
evals.expected_output: It adds an admin-toolbar item linking to the current page's DubBot report, implemented via hook_toolbar() (bridged through Drupal\dubbot_toolbar\ToolbarHandler, which uses the dubbot.link_generator service to build the link).

evals.prompt: What modules must be enabled for the Drupal dubbot_toolbar submodule to work, and does it have its own settings or permissions?
evals.expected_output: It depends on core 'toolbar' and on the parent 'dubbot' module. It has no configuration, settings form, or permissions of its own — it reuses DubBot's dubbot.settings and the access dubbot report / per-pane view dubbot * tab permissions.

evals.prompt: Under what conditions does the dubbot_toolbar item NOT show up for a page?
evals.expected_output: The toolbar item is hidden on 403/404 pages, on pages that anonymous users cannot view (because DubBot can only crawl publicly reachable pages), and when no report link is available for the current route. It is cached per user.permissions and url.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the DubBot toolbar integration active, and which module provides it? Inspect the live site to answer.
evals.expected_output: The dubbot_toolbar submodule is enabled (check `drush pm:list --status=enabled` or moduleHandler). It provides the DubBot admin-toolbar item.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the main DubBot module is installed but the admin toolbar shows no DubBot report shortcut. Enable the feature that adds a DubBot item to the Drupal admin toolbar. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Install/enable the dubbot_toolbar submodule (e.g. `drush en dubbot_toolbar -y`). It provides the hook_toolbar() integration that adds the DubBot toolbar item.
